Line numbers below are those of this head.

### ① Derived judgments

- Published surface: none. `.claude/**` and `scripts/pm/**` belong to no published package; the diff adds no export, schema key, error code or translation key. Right.
- Claim template (`pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` 320, a protocol-semantic face): the `effort:` slot keeps its four values and gains a same-line citation duty for `xhigh`. It narrows what a well-formed claim line is, and no script reads it. Right in direction, incomplete: S1.

- Fold admission (`execution-duties.md` 25 to 33, `area-lease.md` 47): passing the five gates now folds by default; gate ① widens (a same-file text-only arm, a riding p3 exempt); gate ② narrows (same landing tier and L2 tier, a p1 only at the head); a member can be taken out. Each is item 8 or 9 of #35283. Right.
- Effort (`execution-duties.md` 124 to 135): `xhigh` leaves the `security` label, the epic child card and the size word, and attaches to an unattended build of over 30 minutes or a measured gain; the design and red-line re-read goes to `high`; doubt reads `high`, no longer one level up; `low` enters for single-shot helper lookups only, never as a claim value; `max` gains a third ground, to test the ceiling, while decision threads keep their own stricter line (`decision-analysis.md` 45). Right against #35270 as its claim narrowed it; three of these go to ③.
- Security lane (`lanes/security.md`, `security-findings.md` 27): the unit of work moves from one advisory to one group, for the analysis, the order, the branch, the PR, the L2 review and the ledger tag; a low-severity advisory is no longer dispatched alone. Right against items 1 to 7 of #35283, with S2 and S3.
- Line ratchet: three ceilings rise, by 6, 8 and 1 lines; this loosens a gate. The hunks touch ceiling rows and their comments only: no gate logic, no self-test case, no cross-file move declaration. Right under the script header's ordinary ruled raise; see N2.

### ② Semver level

No changeset, and none is owed: nothing in the diff is published. The PR carries `skip-changeset`, and the changeset check on this head's push reads success. The PR body's `Clause-②: no` is right: no published accept set is loosened and no public surface widened, and the change is not a narrowing of a published contract either. `Metadata-protocol: none` is right for the same reason.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Security effort lines (`execution-duties.md` 127 to 130, the diff-review item of 125, `security-findings.md` 27). ESCALATED to the maintainer, to be answered before the merge. Card #35270 calls them a seat proposal to confirm before landing. Medium severity at `high`, and a `security`-labelled card that is no advisory fix by difficulty, follow from his 「安全修复只有高风险的才需要 xhigh 吧」. The build of a high-severity advisory fix at `high` does not: that sentence gives such a fix `xhigh`; the split into a `high` build and one `xhigh` read-only diff review is the seat's answer to his cost question; and the 「同意」 quoted on #35283 names grouping, one analysis and one combined PR, not this split. The card also places its security measurement run before or with these lines; none was made, and the PR reads that run as deciding only a further drop. The line to change if he does not confirm is 128.
- `execution-duties.md` 131, the design and red-line re-read at `high`. ESCALATED to the approver, as the PR asks: it is item 1 of #35270 and waits on no run, and it replaces part of an earlier effort ruling.
- `lanes/security.md` 34, a low-severity advisory only rides. ESCALATED to the maintainer. It is worded as item 5 of #35283, but its stated basis is a current dispatch order, not a standing rule, and it leaves a low-severity advisory that shares nothing in `draft` with no exit state. The line to strike is 34 alone.
- Lines left as they are. Answered, right. The ADR-revision order (`execution-duties.md` 100), and with it ADR in line 125: the card bars that change without the maintainer's own word, and the tier table on `main` records the same order as the effort floor. Four-axis analysis: `decision-analysis.md` 45 and `coordinator.md` 39 on `main` hold decision threads at `xhigh`, and the card's item would contradict them. L2 review: the card ties that level to its review run, and none is recorded; `lanes/l2-review.md` 7 holds the seat session at `high` and states no level for the per-head reviewer, so line 125 is the only place that level lives. Each line is named in the PR, as the card's Done-when allows.
- `Part of #35270`. Answered, right: the three measurement runs and the lines that wait on them stay open on the card. Line 135 states where later values come from; none of the values landing here is a measured one.
- `docs/qa/platform-checklist/RUNNER.md` 94 still sends the fix of a runner's security item at `xhigh`, against the new `checklist-test/SKILL.md` 107. Answered: the file is outside the claim's file surface, the disagreement is in the costlier direction so nothing is under-reviewed meanwhile, and #35270 stays open to carry it. The seat adds it to that card's remaining items.
- No script reads `Fold-with:` or the effort citation. Confirmed on this head: both are rules a seat follows by reading. N1 names the one reader that shares the claim line.
- The analysis file #35283 cites was not readable by the implementing seat, and the lines were composed from the card body. Answered: every item of the card body is carried (④); the visible consequence is the line count in N2.
- Branch name outside the `claude/issue-*` spelling: the PR-body guards read success on this head.
- `open_questions`: none raised. The dev's note on a parenthesis of model family names in the checklist runner skill concerns a line outside the diff; it is not reviewed here and stays with the seat to route.
- SQL push-down: the diff has no data path; nothing to push down.

### ④ Design judgment

No must-fix. Three findings owe a delta review of their fix:

- **S1 (should-fix) — the claim template's `xhigh` citation names two grounds, and the rules of this same head keep a third.** `pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` 320 asks an `xhigh` to cite, on the same line, its duration reading or its measurement record. `execution-duties.md` 100 and 125 keep ADR work at `xhigh` on a standing order, and ADR work is claimed with this template: line 122 puts the effort on the Container and model line. Such a claim has neither thing to cite, so the template can be met only by inventing a reading or by lowering a level the order fixes. Item 5 of #35270 was written for a list without ADR in it; the narrowing on the claim removed that premise and the template was not adjusted. Fix: let the clause name the standing order as a ground, as the `model:` slot beside it already does.
- **S2 (should-fix) — the ledger line moves a whole group on one merge, and the next section lets a group be several PRs.** `lanes/security.md` 25: when the group PR merges, every member's state moves forward together. Line 32: a group too large is split into ordered PRs. A split group has no single group PR, and read as written the first merge marks `merged` the members whose fix sits in a later PR; the same holds for a member whose fix is taken out of the group PR before it lands. The ledger then reads `merged` for an advisory whose fix has not merged. Line 51 still ties `closed` to the fix's own merge, which bounds the damage. Fix: a member moves when the PR that carries its fix merges.
- **S3 (should-fix) — the grouping key admits what the fold gate it points to refuses.** `lanes/security.md` 20 sorts by shared root mechanism and lists `同缺失检查、同门族或同归属包`. With `或`, one owning package is by itself a ground for a group. Line 31 puts every group through the five fold gates, and gate ① (`execution-duties.md` 25) says in terms that the same subsystem is not a family. A package-only set is therefore a group on line 20, owed one analysis on a lead and one PR, and refused at dispatch; and it is wider than the ruling's own words, 「按机制归组」. Line 32 already uses the owning package as a bound. Fix: make it a bound on line 20 as well, not an alternative ground.

- **N1 (nit) — the new same-line citation shares its line with a reader that matches line-wide.** `readContainerModelLine` in `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs` (outside the diff, read only) accepts a ceiling-tier `model:` when the word `MANDATORY` or a `reason:` appears anywhere on the Container and model line. An effort citation spelled with `reason:` would satisfy the tier check for a ceiling nobody derived. The template does not ask for that spelling and no claim uses it today. Follow-up on #35270: scope the reader to the `model:` slot, or give the effort citation words of its own.
- **N2 (nit, prose face) — the fold rows take more lines than the card counted, and the PR body does not say so.** #35283 counts its fold items as one line of growth, in `execution-duties.md`, and words the triage marker as an edit beside the existing suggestion line. This head takes two lines there and one in `triage-duties.md`. The header's rule still holds: each row moves by no more than the measured delta of text the card orders, the byte reasons are in the row comments and match the tree (the gate line at 117 bytes, the audit line at 117, the new line at 109), and `execution-duties.md` moves 6 against 11 ordered lines. Add the card's own count to the PR body's ratchet table, so the approver sees the difference.
- **N3 (nit) — `execution-duties.md` 27, `p1 只作链首`, read as written refuses a fold of two p1 cards.** That is the shape of this PR's own fold, which #35283 invited when it said the two cards may land in one PR.
